entries.question: Kya hospital somvar ko band rahega
entries.answer:
KGMU mein emergency services 24/7 (hamesha) khuli rehti hain.

Somvar (Monday) ko hospital ki OPD aur administrative vibhag khule rehte hain, lekin agar us din koi sarvajanik avkash (Gazetted Holiday) hai, toh OPD aur OT band rahenge. 

Kripya dhyaan dein:
1. **Emergency:** Trauma Centre aur emergency services kabhi band nahi hoti hain.
2. **OPD:** Somvar ko OPD samanya roop se subah 9:00 baje se chalti hai. 
3. **Holiday:** Agar aap kisi vishesh chhutti ke baare mein pooch rahe hain, toh kripya upar di gayi "KGMU HOLIDAY CALENDAR 2026" ki soochi dekhein.

Agar aapko ilaaj ke liye aana hai, toh online registration (ORS/ABHA) ya walk-in ke madhyam se OPD slip lena anivarya (mandatory) hai.

entries.question: Aur ak baat sir stamp paper bhi kahe h banwane ko to uspe signature sirf mera hona chahiye

Stamp paper par banwaye jaane wale affidavit (jise aksar "Anti-Ragging Affidavit" ya "Admission Affidavit" kehte hain) ke liye ye niyam hote hain:

1.  **Signature kiska hoga:** Isme **aapka signature** hona zaroori hai, lekin saath hi aapke **Parents/Guardian ka signature** bhi hona chahiye. Ye affidavit ek legal document hota hai, isliye is par dono (student aur parent) ke signature zaroori hote hain.
2.  **Notary:** Sirf sign karne se kaam nahi chalega. Stamp paper par matter (content) type karwane ke baad, aapko kisi **Notary Public (vakeel)** ke paas jana hoga. Vahan notary ki seal aur signature hona bahut zaroori hai, tabhi wo "valid" (manya) mana jayega.
3.  **Content (Matter):** College se zarur puch lein ki affidavit mein kya likhwana hai. Aksar ye do tarah ke hote hain:
    *   **Anti-Ragging Affidavit:** Isme likha hota hai ki aap ragging mein involve nahi honge.
    *   **General Affidavit:** Isme aapki personal details aur ye likha hota hai ki aap sabhi rules follow karenge.
4.  **Stamp Paper ki Value:** College ne jitne rupaye ka stamp paper bola hai (jaise 10, 50, ya 100 ka), wahi lein.

**Aapko kya karna chahiye:**
*   College ke Admission Office se ek baar **"Affidavit ka format"** maangein. Kai baar wo log khud hi format de dete hain ki isse type karwa lo.
*   Jab aap stamp paper par matter type karwa lein, toh us par **apna aur apne father/mother ka signature** karein.
*   Uske baad pass ke kisi court ya notary ke paas jakar usse **attest (Notary stamp)** karwayein.

**Ek zaroori baat:** I'm not qualified to provide legal advice, lekin admission ke liye ye standard procedure hai. Apne admission cell se confirm kar lein ki unhe "Notarized" affidavit chahiye ya nahi.
